descriptor: Team workspace with a fourteen-day trial

voice.summary: Loomwork speaks like a considerate shopkeeper greeting someone new. It is warm, clear about the trial and gently handy with metaphors from weaving.
dos: Tell new users exactly what happens next
Use woven imagery sparingly: thread, warp, weave
State trial length and cost every time
donts: Do not ask for a card on sign-up
Do not use dark patterns or pressure
Do not use passwords jargon like 'entropy'

taglines: Weave your work into one place
boilerplate: Loomwork is a team workspace that is free for fourteen days with no card required, built to weave projects, people and documents into one place.

microcopy.error: That password is too short. Use at least 10 characters.
microcopy.empty: No workspace yet. Create one to begin.

logo.note: A woven grid refers directly to a loom and to a workspace of crossing threads.
